subject: Business
title: Demand Forecasting: Predicting the Future
description: One-minute skill: Demand Forecasting: Predicting the Future.

hook.text: Walmart's systems detected Pop-Tart sales spiking before hurricanes. Now they pre-stock Pop-Tarts along storm paths.

buildup.text: Demand forecasting uses historical data, trends, and external signals to predict what customers will buy.

discovery.text: Accurate forecasts reduce waste, prevent stockouts, and optimize production schedules across the supply chain.

twist.text: All forecasts are wrong. The goal isn't perfection — it's being less wrong than your competitors.

climax.text: Machine learning now incorporates weather, social media, and economic indicators to improve forecast accuracy.

punchline.text: You can't predict the future. But you can prepare for the most likely version.

quiz.question: Why does Walmart pre-stock Pop-Tarts along hurricane paths?
options: Data showed Pop-Tart sales spike before hurricanes
Pop-Tarts are the cheapest product to ship
Customers specifically request them during evacuations

details.summary: Demand forecasting uses historical data, statistical models, and market intelligence to predict future customer demand. Accurate forecasts drive purchasing, production planning, and inventory decisions that determine whether products are available when customers want them.
details.whyItMatters: Forecasting accuracy directly impacts profitability. Overforecasting creates excess inventory and markdowns. Underforecasting causes stockouts and lost sales. Even small improvements in accuracy cascade into significant cost savings.
takeaways: Statistical models analyze historical patterns to project future demand
Qualitative inputs like market intelligence supplement quantitative models
Forecast accuracy degrades with longer time horizons and greater granularity

faq.question: What methods are commonly used for demand forecasting?
faq.answer: Time series analysis identifies trends and seasonality in historical data. Causal models link demand to drivers like price, promotions, and economic indicators. Machine learning models capture complex nonlinear patterns. Most companies combine multiple methods.

faq.question: Why is demand forecasting always imperfect?
faq.answer: Consumer behavior is inherently unpredictable. New competitors, weather events, viral trends, and macroeconomic shifts create uncertainty no model can fully capture. The goal is not perfect accuracy but reducing error enough to make better inventory decisions.
